verdict.rationale: AFK runs tasks as directed graphs of steps, so error-handling paths and failure notifications are a fair question for it, but the evidence never documents error branches, error workflows, or alerts when a run fails. The closest items are adjacent and do not count: blocked nodes resuming when dependencies clear describes dependency waiting, and KPI alerts concern business metrics, not run failures.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define dedicated error-handling paths or error workflows and get notified when a run fails
